dct_title_s: Map of the Klamath gold region
dct_description_sm: drawn by H. Ehrenburg, from superficial surveys in the spring of 1850.
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Text below map describes the area and where gold has been found.
Printed on newspaper cover, Thursday, August 15, 1850.
The maps, plans and sketches of Herman Ehrenberg by Diane North, California Map Society, no. 11, 1988
Mapping Transmississippi West by Carl I. Wheat, v. 3, no. 672.
